text:
Cold logic will never get you there. Emotion will.

You wrote your goal down. Nothing moves.

Your subconscious ignores cold logic. It responds to feeling.

Mix thought with emotion. Faith. Desire. Belief. Your subconscious wakes up and the mountain starts moving.

You write goals and never feel them. Plan stays dead.

Your goal moves when you FEEL it deeply. Not think about it. Feel it as already real.

Emotion moves mountains. Cold logic just watches.
caption:
Most men plan without feeling. That's why nothing moves.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
